title: ServiceTitan Voice Agent Alternatives for Service Businesses
seo_title: ServiceTitan Voice Agent Alternatives: Compare Options & Fit
description: Compare ServiceTitan Voice Agent alternatives: Off The Clock AI, Podium, Sameday and Avoca. Per-call pricing, dispatch context and job quotes.
intro: Your customer asked what the project costs. The fee for coming out is only part of that answer.
verdict: Choose Off The Clock when the goal is a priced job and a booked appointment without buying a new field-service platform. QuoteDone applies your rates to the project—not simply the fee for the visit.
reason: ServiceTitan Voice Agent uses the business’s configured job types and booking context. Its settings include dispatch-fee messages for an unspecified fee, a free visit or a specific amount. Those are useful pricing answers, but a dispatch fee is not automatically the project total. [[st-settings]]

The official indexed public offer lists $2.75 per call. That is an agent usage rate, not a complete ServiceTitan subscription. Multiple-agent configurations also allow distinct settings for brands or service lines. [[st-pricing]] [[st-multi]]

Off The Clock’s proposition is the customer inquiry itself: answer, establish the supported job price, book and follow up. QuoteDone gives phone and website inquiries a route through your own pricing without turning the purchase into a new field-service system.
choices: Calculate the supported job, not only the visit fee

Your labor, materials and selected extras belong to the job the customer asked about. QuoteDone uses the supported inputs and owner-approved pricing; an unresolved quantity stays in a complete request for owner review. A transfer to your business remains available when a person is needed.
An operator within a bundled operating system

Larry has price-book and dispatch-board access. Podium’s advertised home-services package includes its FSM as well. That wider bundle is a different purchase from adding an operator beside the software you already use. [[podium-larry]] [[podium-plans]]

Sameday lists ServiceTitan in its integration directory and publishes minute-based packages. Phones, campaigns and coaching are also part of the product range. Specific connected actions remain dependent on the purchased setup. [[sameday-integrations]] [[sameday-product]]
A connected front office with call coaching

Avoca documents direct ServiceTitan booking and customer-context writeback, alongside Coach and its trained-human program. The selected modules and human-program terms determine what is included. [[avoca-servicetitan]] [[avoca-coach]]
decision: Choose Off The Clock when pricing the job is the result you want from the inquiry. Keep the business software you need, while QuoteDone carries your own prices to the customer on the phone and your website.
faqs: Does ServiceTitan Voice Agent only serve enterprise contact centers?
No. ServiceTitan documents Voice Agent features across different phone configurations. [[st-escalation]]
Is the $2.75 figure the total cost of ServiceTitan?

No. It is the Voice Agent per-call amount in the indexed official offer. The direct page is JavaScript-rendered; the source note identifies the retrieval method. Account costs and offer eligibility are separate. [[st-pricing]]
card_description: Compare ServiceTitan’s per-call voice offer and dispatch-fee controls with QuoteDone’s job-pricing subscription and three named alternatives.
sections: Compare calls with calls—and minutes with minutes

QuoteDone is $279 per month with 1,200 included minutes and $0.35 per extra minute; the offer includes the operator and website quote widget with no setup fee. ServiceTitan’s indexed $2.75 rate is per call. There is no universal call-to-minute conversion. [[st-pricing]]

The useful comparison is your recorded usage alongside the job each product completes. Call duration matters for the usage comparison; a new ServiceTitan customer must also account for the underlying software subscription.
Answer the question the customer actually asked

A customer requesting a roof repair wants to understand the repair, not only the cost of having someone attend. The affected area, confirmed repair details and your pricing determine whether a supported quote can be produced.

QuoteDone keeps those facts and the selected scope together. When diagnosis or measurements are still needed, the request reaches you with that uncertainty intact. The operator removes repeat intake where it can; it does not replace inspection with guesswork.
